sloka: प्रमत्तान् अप्रमत्तान् वा नरा माम्स अशिनो भृशम् ।विध्यन्ति विमुखाम् च अपि न च दोषो अत्र विद्यते ॥४-१८-३९॥
transliteration: pramattān apramattān vā narā māmsa aśino bhṛśam ।vidhyanti vimukhām ca api na ca doṣo atra vidyate ॥4-18-39॥

translations.english: 'People seeking animal flesh for food kill animals alarmed or unalarmed, animals that run away or animals that stand still. They kill animals whether they are alert or not and no blemish is attached.
